sloka: त्वयि मद्बाणनिर्दग्धे पतिते ऽद्य निशाचर ।पुरे जनपदे चापि क्षेममेव भविष्यति ।। ७.६९.६ ॥
transliteration: tvayi madbāṇanirdagdhe patite 'dya niśācara ।pure janapade cāpi kṣemameva bhaviṣyati ।। 7.69.6 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna declared that with Lavaṇa, the night-wanderer, burnt by his arrows and fallen today, there would indeed be welfare in both the city and the country.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! यह वोय वहां था, जो उववशी को लक्ष्य कर घड़े में रखा गया था । परन्तु था वरुण जी का
